character: High-speed, 7km flowing circuit with huge elevation changes and unpredictable weather. Rewards bravery, smooth inputs, and good exits onto long straights.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/circuit-guide-everything-you-need-to-know-about-spa-francorchamps circuit character/corners; long-established F1 circuit knowledge

corners.name: La Source
corners.technique: Brake hard 100m before, late apex, smooth throttle on exit — exit speed feeds Eau Rouge
corners.trap: Early apex causes wheelspin on exit, ruining Kemmel Straight speed

corners.name: Eau Rouge
corners.technique: Approach flat-out or with minor lift, minimal steering input, let the car flow up the hill
corners.trap: Too much steering input unsettles the car; lifting too much costs massive straight speed

corners.name: Raidillon
corners.technique: Aim for inside kerb at crest, keep car balanced as it goes light over the top
corners.trap: Running wide over the crest onto exit kerb — high crash risk

corners.name: Les Combes
corners.technique: Brake 120m before T5, hard straight-line braking, smooth transitions through the chicane
corners.trap: Excessive kerb usage on T6 causes instability and poor exit onto Malmedy straight

corners.name: Malmedy
corners.technique: Trail brake to late apex, use full track width on exit
corners.trap: Early turn-in leads to running wide and slow exit

corners.name: Rivage
corners.technique: Late apex, patient throttle — exit leads into fast section
corners.trap: Braking too late on the downhill approach, missing the apex

corners.name: Pouhon
corners.technique: Commit to the entry, carry speed through both apexes with smooth steering
corners.trap: Lifting mid-corner kills momentum through an entire sector

corners.name: Fagnes
corners.technique: Light braking, smooth direction changes, use kerbs carefully
corners.trap: Over-driving causes snap oversteer on direction change

corners.name: Stavelot
corners.technique: Late first apex, short straight, then commit to second part — exit speed is critical
corners.trap: Too much speed into first part compromises second apex and exit onto Courbe Paul Frère

corners.name: Courbe Paul Frère
corners.technique: Near-flat off Stavelot's exit — minimal lift, let the car run out to track edge to set up Blanchimont
corners.trap: Lifting early or running wide scrubs momentum all the way through Blanchimont onto the Bus Stop straight

corners.name: Blanchimont
corners.technique: Flat in most cars, tiny lift if needed — smooth steering only
corners.trap: Any snap correction at 250+ km/h risks losing the car

corners.name: Bus Stop
corners.technique: Brake 130m before, hard and late. Clean exit feeds start/finish straight
corners.trap: Over-committing on entry; poor exit loses time all down the pit straight
